column1: # Dual-slot OTA layout for the ESP32-C6FH4's 4 MB flash. nvs/phy_init keep the IDF default
# offsets (the cached Thread dataset in nvs survives the migration from the old single-factory
# layout). No factory partition: USB flashing writes ota_0
# otadata. 2x 1984K is the largest symmetric pair that fits 4 MB with these offsets; the
# ~1.8 MB app leaves ~160K headroom per slot (esp_delta_ota is the escape hatch if outgrown).
